_about: Per-stage logic. Atoms: TW Tail Whack, BS Butt Stomp, HJ High Jump (needs BS too), LJ Long Jump, CC Climbing Claws, PG Power Gloves, LW Lever Wrench, VL Vehicle License, JB orange/blue jelly, JG lime/green jelly, JP strawberry/purple jelly, CG Clockwork Gobbo, GG the stage's Golden Gobbo area (all five of its coloured crystals), TH carry and throw an object (Power Gloves). '&' and, '|' or, '' nothing. A crystal number's rule = default & (box rule if it is a box crystal) & every matching entry in rules. Sources: StrategyWiki walkthrough and the GameFAQs guide by Robshi, matched to crystal clusters by landmarks (tools/crystal_clusters.py).

T1L2.name: Find the Key! Save the Gobbo!
T1L2.notes: Open level: pits are jumped, the third uses a rope, hippos lift Croc. Yellow needs the orange jelly marker (both guides).

T1L3.name: Find 5 Lost Treasure Chests
T1L3.notes: Mine carts and bomb boxes need no ability. Red needs a triple jump and yellow the orange jelly (both guides). Numbers 51-100 are the five chests, 10 each.

T1L4.name: Get the Gobbo's Sandwich!
rules: past the gear box in the cave after the clearing (platforms only appear once it is stomped)
box on top of the monkey bars; Robshi: triple jump onto the bars
box above the lime jelly marker (both guides)
T1L4.notes: The level opens with monkey bars over spikes, so everything needs Climbing Claws. The crow is killed with the tail and the exit gong is hit with it.

T1L6.name: Save the Bird from the Thief
rules: on the monkey bars in the first cave, with the red crystal
Clockwork Gobbo section, reached from the lime jelly marker (both guides)
T1L6.notes: Ropes, hippos and crumbling boxes need no ability. The thief is killed with an attack and the exit gong is hit with the tail.

T1L5.name: Croc Vs Dantini Boat Race
T1L5.notes: A boat race. All 100 crystals are the prize (100 for 1st, 70 for 2nd, 50 for 3rd). Red is on the shortcut, green on the normal track.

T2L2.name: Save the Ice Trapped Gobbos!
rules: the platform above the strawberry jelly marker, with the red crystal (both guides)
Clockwork Gobbo section; reaching the marker needs the ice holes stomped
the box behind the Gobbo freed with the TNT barrel
T2L2.notes: Nineteen of the twenty sources are boxes. Caves are entered by stomping cracked ice. Purple needs a triple jump off a gear box (both guides). The exit is opened by throwing a TNT barrel.

T2L3.name: Chase the Choo Choo Train
rules: on the crumbling platforms a gear box creates, with the purple crystal
box reached with a triple jump (both guides)
box beside the key, on the hidden path reached by a triple jump off the cage (both guides)
T2L3.notes: Yellow is caged; its key is on the triple-jump path. The level ends by hitting the red lever with the tail.

T2L5.name: It's just Snowball Madness!
T2L5.notes: Croc rides a snowball for the whole level; boxes are broken by rolling into them, so no ability is used.

T2L6.name: Hang Glider Valley
T2L6.notes: A hang glider flight. Crystals come from nine hoops of ten and the landing.

T2L7.name: KaBooom! It's Roger Red Ant
rules: the ledge and corridor above the orange jelly marker at the start (both guides)
first room, left path: the timer-switch room behind the first TNT door
first room, right path: over the bomb boxes behind a TNT door
second room and its left path: only open once both first-room paths are done, which needs the stomp switches
second room, right path: the multi-arrow platform room
Clockwork Gobbo section in the third room
T2L7.notes: Every door past the first room is blown open by carrying a TNT box to it and throwing it. Only the boxes by the entrance and the jelly ledge are free of that.

T3L2.name: Find the Wheels in the Jungle!
rules: everything past the first vine wall
two boxes on top of the monkey bars by the first key: triple jump (both guides)
past the gear box whose platforms cross the lava after the first wheel
crystals on top of the monkey bars in the large cave: triple jump
boxes above the two orange jelly markers
T3L2.notes: Only the two boxes by the entrance come before the first climb. The second wheel and yellow are at the far end; yellow needs a triple jump.

T3L3.name: Find the Wheels in the Mine!
rules: Clockwork Gobbo section, straight after the first mine cart
two boxes above the lime jelly marker (both guides)
along and beyond the rails cleared by hitting the red levers
T3L3.notes: First wheel: explosive crates are picked up from the monkey bars and thrown at the glass crate. Second wheel: two levers. The exit is a Swap Meet Pete gong. Whether the second cave can be reached without the first lever is not settled by the guides, so it is treated as needing it.

T3L4.name: Race Day at Goldrock
T3L4.notes: A kart race; all 100 crystals are the prize. In the unmodified game the door needs the four racer wheels.

T3L5.name: Climb The Devil's Tower
rules: Clockwork Gobbo section, with the blue crystal
two boxes above the lime jelly marker (both guides)
two boxes inside the Golden Gobbo area
T3L5.notes: The second screen already needs two rock walls climbed, so everything needs Climbing Claws. Red is reached by platforms a gear box creates.

T3L7.name: Save 50 Trapped Gobbos!
rules: Gobbos past the first rock wall
the last Gobbos need gear boxes stomped and a triple jump onto a rock; 51-100 are the bonus for rescuing all fifty
T3L7.notes: No loose crystals: one per Gobbo rescued, in the order they are saved, then fifty for saving them all. Water for the fires is picked up in the level. About a dozen Gobbos come before the first climb (StrategyWiki route).

T4L2.name: Save 30 Gobbo babies!
rules: crystals on the raised walkway, reached by a triple jump from the flowerbed
crystals on roofs: triple jump (both guides)
two per baby put in a crib without crying; three babies are on the walkway
T4L2.notes: Babies are carried and thrown into cribs. The Golden Gobbo is in a cage opened by a red lever.

T4L3.name: Up the Waterfall
rules: Clockwork Gobbo section, with the blue crystal
free: the box and crystals on the first ledge, before the triple jump
above the orange jelly marker at the start, with the yellow crystal
T4L3.notes: Both guides: the ledge after the first box needs a triple jump, then a vine wall. Which crystals sit on the first ledge is judged from positions next to the start and the jelly marker.

T4L5.name: Bride of the Dungeon of Defright
rules: puzzles 2 and 3: stomping the arrows, and stomping the runaway box
puzzles 4 and 5: reached after throwing three TNT barrels
T4L5.notes: Five timed puzzles worth 20 each, in a fixed order.

T4L6.name: Goo Man Chu's Tower
T4L6.notes: Fifteen boxes, three rings of eight and one loose crystal on a running-and-jumping climb. The level ends by hitting the valve with the tail.
